key4friends_update.description: Updates a Key4Friends guest key and notifies the guest. Omitted fields are left unchanged; the email address cannot be changed.

locks.name: Authorized locks
locks.description: Locks the guest is allowed to operate. Replaces the current authorizations.

lock_names.name: Guest lock names
lock_names.description: Names shown to the guest instead of the system lock names. Provide one entry per lock to rename, with the device ID of the lock as the key and the name to show as the value. Renamed locks must be among the authorized locks; locks without an entry keep their current guest-facing name, and newly authorized locks default to their system name.
